title: Lyft
description: Lyft's Tetris design system documents primary brand colours including pink (#ff00bf), mulberry (#352384), purple (#4901b8), magenta (#b80b8c), charcoal (#333447), and neutrals (#474c62, #728099, #bfc7d9, #d8dce6, #f3f3f5), plus secondary red (#e60000), orange (#faa33b), yellow (#fcee22), green (#33d9c2), and blue (#2aace3). Hex values are defined in Lyft's official Tetris stylesheet.
